entities.name: Awateh
entities.description: Grand Historian of Femeref and a key member of the Council of Voices, an elder who argued against aiding the Efravan caravan.

entities.name: Femeref
entities.description: City on Jamuraa in Dominaria governed by a council.

entities.name: Niambi
entities.description: Speaker and advisor who advocated for the Efravans.

entities.name: Sidar Teshunda
entities.description: The Sidar of Femeref, caught between security and compassion, who finally welcomed the Efravans.

entities.name: Efravan caravan
entities.description: Refugees from the Efravan tribes whom the council debated aiding.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian whose legacy Awateh feared lingered.

events.summary: In the Great Chamber Awateh argues against Niambi's challenge to the decree denying aid to the Efravan caravan, fearing Phyrexian infiltrators.
events.quote: Awateh argued against Niambi , a speaker and advisor

events.summary: Awateh's rhetoric contributes to the Council's unanimous decision to reject aid to the Efravan.
events.quote: Awateh's rhetoric contributed significantly to the Council's unanimous decision to reject aid

events.summary: Days later, Awateh and two councilors see Niambi bringing the Sidar to the Efravan mines and rush after him, arriving too late.
events.quote: They shouted for Teshunda to stop, but their voices were unheeded.

events.summary: Teshunda welcomes the Efravan to Femeref despite the councilors' protestations.
events.quote: Teshunda had made up his mind and welcomed the Efravan to Femeref

relations.quote: a key member of the Council of Voices in Femeref

relations.note: opposed her advocacy for the Efravans

he had brought councilors Gbega and Jabras to his side
